name: 74578 · Wilburton, OK
findings: ZIP 74578 (Wilburton) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74578 (Wilburton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
88% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
